vision.problem: A solo developer using AI coding agents loses track of what to build next, why, and where work stopped, because agents forget between sessions and act on every idea at once.
vision.customer: A solo developer, or a very small team, who builds with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex, and installs skills into their repositories.

outcomes.text: `npx skills add https://github.com/purview-dev/pm-skills -y` followed by `pm-setup` leaves a repository with the rules merged, and every pm-* skill and every workflow skill reported installed.
After compaction or a new session, `pm-resume` names the active item, its stage, and the next action from `planning/` alone.

During an active workflow, only the Non-interruption rules' exceptions run (capture, `pm-checkpoint` stage, done, push and pop, `pm-pause`, `pm-revise`, and the read-only views and checks); every other PM skill waits, and a capture replies in one line while the step in progress resumes.
`pm-export` writes a schema-valid `planning.json`, and `pm-docs-site` builds a site from it whose `just docs-check` passes.

Technical decisions are recorded and followed: `pm-init` records an existing repository's technology and principles, the design handoff names the ADRs and principles that apply, and `pm-checkpoint` (`done`) refuses to close an item whose command checks fail.

outOfScope: Teams and shared boards: multi-user assignment, permissions, or a shared hosted board. PM state is files in one repository.
Non-Bun tooling: npm- or pnpm-only toolchains for validation and the docs site.

constraints.stack: Markdown skills, Bun scripts, just, markdownlint-cli2, GitHub Actions

focus.whyNow: every item in Next serves it, and the brief `planning/briefs/2026-11-17-docs-site-package.md` records copied templates, unpinned packages, and rules bumps for template changes as current costs.

inbox.title: R-010 deferred board polish
inbox.idea:
Minor findings from R-010's task and final reviews, triaged "can wait":

- The 3s reveal of a pending board also fires on a slow but successful hydration (brief unfiltered view, then the filtered one); say so in `components.css` and the `useBoardUrlState.ts` header, or tune it.
- The pending mark is also set on `/plan/roadmap/?owner=...` (inert today); scope it to the Board page when R-011 adds Roadmap filters.
- `useBoardUrlState` `replaceState` drops non-board query parameters and `history.state`.
- The lane header is a plain `div`; an `h3` or `role="heading"` would make lanes navigable.
- Before hydration, `aria-expanded` is `true` on columns the pre-paint script already collapsed.
- The card list is serialised into the island's `props` beside the rendered HTML, roughly doubling the Board page; watch it for R-011 and R-012.
- A collapsed column's vertical title stretches the shared header row.
- `kanban.css` duplicates the Astro cards' scoped styles and keeps dead `.k-item:focus-visible` and `cursor: grab` (suggests drag and drop); its header comment lists only some changes.
- `board.ts`: repeated `(X as string[]).includes` casts; `lanes()` branches repeat their tail; `lanes(..., 'none')` returns the input array.
- `board-data.ts` casts loose owner strings to `Owner | null`; no fixture Done entry with a null `id` (key fallback, `href: null`, and the Done-tag rule untested); `tagHref` never asserted.
- `integration.test.ts` asserts the integration names two ways.
- `install.test.ts` uses a 60s `afterAll` timeout for slow Windows `rmSync`.
- The `dev` Playwright project adds about 25s per browser run and leaves one temp folder per machine; the optimizeDeps guard is untested under Yarn PnP.

inbox.title: Island import guard skips Astro files
inbox.idea: R-028 final review: `test/island-imports.test.ts` scans only `.ts` and `.tsx` under `src/components`. An `.astro` component script that value-imports a server-only lib inside a client `<script>` would not be caught. Decide whether `.astro` client scripts need the same guard.

inbox.title: Popup script listeners stack on re-run
inbox.idea: R-028 final review: `start()` in `src/scripts/plan.ts` adds `pointerdown`, `pointerup`, and `click` listeners on `document` each time it runs. If it ever runs twice on one page (for example under Astro view transitions), the listeners stack. Guard `start()` so it runs once per document.

inbox.title: Board storage test pins Starlight error counts
inbox.idea: R-028: the test `a localStorage that throws leaves the Board usable` excludes Starlight theme-script errors by name, message, and an exact count per `<starlight-theme-select>`. A Starlight upgrade that changes those scripts will fail it with no fault in the package; update the expected counts then, or report the unguarded `localStorage` read upstream to Starlight.

inbox.title: Template site keeps R-028 accessibility gaps
inbox.idea: R-028 fixed the popup trigger, backdrop close, heading levels, card tab stops, collapse toggles, and timeline zoom focus in `packages/pm-docs-site` only. The copies in `skills/pm-docs-site/templates/` and the rendered `docs-site/` keep the old gaps until R-013 Docs-site package: publish and migrate moves the site onto the package. Check R-013 removes them, or port the fixes if R-013 slips.

inbox.title: Template docs site still logs the 404 warning
inbox.idea: R-031 fixes the `[WARN] [content] Entry docs → 404 was not found.` warning in the package (`packages/pm-docs-site`), but `docs-site/` is still rendered from `skills/pm-docs-site/templates/site`, so `just docs-check` still logs it. Fixing the template is a `skills/` change (a rules bump); R-013's migration to the package removes it, or the template takes the package's fix: Starlight's `disable404Route: true` and its own `src/pages/404.astro` (a draft `404` docs entry is not an option: it prints Starlight's draft notice on the live page).

(3) `src/pages/plan/log.astro` labels an ID that is known but whose page is not built with the logged title, not the export's current title, and no test covers that view-off case.

briefs.title: Docs site as a versioned package
briefs.decision: 2026-11-17 Add to Next. R-008 Docs-site package: skeleton at parity and R-014 Create the npm @purview-dev scope and token at the bottom of Next; R-009 to R-013 at the bottom of Later in dependency order. R-002, R-005, and R-007 dropped (folded in or already built). Reason: the problems are evidenced in the current templates and scripts, and the user chose the full package with every view in the first release.
briefs.problem: The docs site is chaotic to maintain and builds non-deterministically: each consumer carries its own copy of the templates, resolves its own package versions, and any template change forces a rules-major bump on every consumer.
briefs.doneWhen: `docs-site/` contains only `package.json`, `astro.config.mjs`, and `bun.lock` (plus `.gitignore`), and `just docs-check` passes.

briefs.title: pm-docs-site package in TypeScript only
briefs.decision: 2026-11-18 Added to Next (top) as R-021 Docs-site package: TypeScript source with a build step (agent, M, serves V4, M1). R-017 Docs-site package: in-repo dev hydrates and R-019 Docs-site package: consumer-ready for 1.0.0 depend on it; R-019 moved to the top of Later. Why: the user chose a build step so the source is TypeScript and Node consumers keep working.
briefs.problem: The user's rule (2026-11-18): TypeScript only (`.mts`/`.ts`/`.tsx`, run with Bun), never `.js` or `.mjs`. The `@purview-dev/pm-docs-site` package still has ten JavaScript files, and R-017 Docs-site package: in-repo dev hydrates cannot add its helper until the package can load TypeScript.
briefs.doneWhen: `git ls-files packages/pm-docs-site` lists no `.js`, `.mjs`, or `.cjs` file.

briefs.title: Technology and engineering principles sections
briefs.decision: 2026-11-20 Keep it parked. Reason: SCOPE CHANGE to v1; no `V` line or milestone covers it and M1 Reproducible docs site is the current focus. Next: `pm-strategy` adds a `V` line and a milestone after M1, then the four slices go to Later under it.
briefs.problem: A solo developer's technology choices, adopted packages, and engineering principles are decided once and then lost: nothing in PM state records what was adopted and why (answer 2026-11-20).
briefs.doneWhen: `pm-init` in a scratch repository with a `package.json` and an `AGENTS.md` writes `planning/ENGINEERING.md` with `## Technology` and `## Principles`, each entry citing its `Source`, and `pm-lint check` passes on it.

briefs.title: Where do ADRs fit in
briefs.decision: 2026-11-22 Keep it parked. Reason: SCOPE CHANGE to v1; no `V` line or milestone covers it and M1 Reproducible docs site is the current focus. Answer to the question: ADRs record technical decisions only, live in a configurable `docs/adr/`, are written by the design stage, and are read by every session through the managed rules. Next: `pm-strategy` adds a `V` line and a milestone after M1 covering this and the engineering-principles brief.
briefs.problem: Technical decisions (why this library, why this pattern) are buried in each item's design spec and are not findable later, by the user or by an agent (answer 2026-11-22).
briefs.doneWhen: `pm-init` in a scratch repository with `docs/adr/` writes `ADR directory: docs/adr/` to `planning/config.md`, and `pm-lint check` passes.

revisions.text: ADRs were to live in a configurable `docs/adr/`, recorded by an `ADR directory` setting. Must now: live in `<PM root>/decisions/`, written only by the new `pm-adr` skill and linted by `pm-lint`; the `ADR directory` setting and the `docs/adr/` default are dropped, and `pm-adr import` brings an existing folder in (user, 2026-11-22). Mode: fix-in-place. Supersedes: the `Done when` above and R-033's old title.

briefs.decision: 2026-11-20 Build it now. R-020 keeps its ID and place at Next 1, with this brief and the Done when above. Why: it serves the M1 focus, and the user chose to build it now over adding it to Next or Later.
